<p><strong>task1.c源代码</strong></p>
<details>
<summary>点击查看代码</summary>
<pre><code>#include&lt;stdlib.h&gt;
#include&lt;time.h&gt;

#define N 5
#define N1 80
#define N2 35

int main(){
	int cnt;
	int random_majior, random_no;
    srand(time(NULL));
	

	cnt = 0;
	while (cnt &lt; N) {
		random_majior = rand() % 2;

		if (random_majior) {
			random_no = rand() % N1 + 1;
			printf("20256343%04d\n", random_no);

		}
		else {
			random_no = rand() % N2 + 1;
			printf("20256136%04d\n", random_no);

		}
		cnt++;

	}
	return 0;
}
</code></pre>
</details>
<p><strong>运行结果截图</strong><br>
去掉前：<br>
<img alt="屏幕截图 2025-10-19 145356" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3708057/202510/3708057-20251019145513611-1605440263.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="屏幕截图 2025-10-19 145336" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3708057/202510/3708057-20251019145526414-597473150.png" class="lazyload"><br>
两次随机生成的数字不同</p>
<p>去掉后：<br>
<img alt="屏幕截图 2025-10-19 145230" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3708057/202510/3708057-20251019145605612-2094933981.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="屏幕截图 2025-10-19 145216" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3708057/202510/3708057-20251019145619240-1127100752.png" class="lazyload"><br>
两次随机生成的数虽然随机但相同</p>
<p><strong>回答问题</strong><br>
srand(time(NULL))的作用：设置随机数种子，使生成的数字完全随机<br>
程序的作用：随机生成两个专业的学号中的5个学号</p>
<p><strong>task2.c源代码</strong></p>
<details>
<summary>点击查看代码</summary>
<pre><code>#include &lt;stdio.h&gt;
int main() {
 &nbsp; &nbsp;int choice, quantity;
 &nbsp; &nbsp;float total_price = 0, amount_paid, change;
 &nbsp; &nbsp;while (1) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;printf("\n自动饮料售卖机菜单:\n");
 &nbsp; &nbsp;   &nbsp;printf("1. 可乐 - 3 元/瓶\n");
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;printf("2. 雪碧 - 3 元/瓶\n");
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;printf("3. 橙汁 - 5 元/瓶\n");
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;printf("4. 矿泉水 - 2 元/瓶\n");
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;printf("0. 退出购买流程\n");
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;printf("请输入饮料编号: ");
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;scanf("%d", &amp;choice);
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;if (choice == 0)
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;break;
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;if (choice &lt; 1 || choice &gt; 4) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;printf("无效的饮料编号，请重新输入。\n");
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;continue;
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;printf("请输入购买的数量: ");
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;scanf("%d", &amp;quantity);
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;if (quantity &lt; 0) {
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;printf("购买数量不能为负数，请重新输入。\n");
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;continue;
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;if(choice == 1 || choice == 2)
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;total_price += 3 * quantity;
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;else if(choice == 3)
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;total_price += 5 * quantity;
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;else
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;total_price += 2 * quantity;
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;printf("请投入金额: ");
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;scanf("%f", &amp;amount_paid);
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;change = amount_paid - total_price;
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;printf("本次购买总价: %.2f 元\n", total_price);
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;printf("找零: %.2f 元\n", change);
 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;total_price = 0;
 &nbsp;  }
 &nbsp; &nbsp;printf("感谢您的购买，欢迎下次光临！\n");
return 0;
}
</code></pre>
</details>
<p><strong>运行结果截图</strong><br>
<img alt="屏幕截图 2025-10-19 151549" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3708057/202510/3708057-20251019151619495-1951283167.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong>回答问题</strong><br>
若去掉line 47,会引发程序异常导致中止<br>
continue的作用：继续循环中的下一步</p>
<p><strong>task3.c源代码</strong></p><details><p></p>
<summary>点击查看代码</summary>
<pre><code>#define _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS
#include&lt;stdio.h&gt;

int main() {
	char color;


	while (1) {
		scanf("%c", &amp;color);
		getchar();
		if (color == 'y')
		{
			printf("wait a minute\n");
		}
		else if (color == 'r')
		{
			printf("stop!\n");
		}
		else if (color == 'g')
		{
			printf("go go go\n");
		}
		else
		{
			printf("something must be wrong...\n");
		}
	}
	return 0;
}
</code></pre>
</details>

<p><strong>task4.c源代码</strong></p>
<details>
<summary>点击查看代码</summary>
<pre><code>#define _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS
#include&lt;stdio.h&gt;

int main() {

	double sum = 0, max_num = 0, min_num = 20000, num;


	printf("输入今日开销，直到输入-1时终止：\n");
	while (1) {
		scanf("%lf", &amp;num);
		if (num &gt; max_num) {
			max_num = num;
		}
		if (num &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; num &lt; min_num) {
			min_num = num;
		}
		sum += num;
		if (num == -1)
			break;
	}
	printf("今日累计消费总额：%.1lf\n", sum);
	printf("今日最高一笔开销：%.1lf\n", max_num);
	printf("今日最低一笔开销：%.1lf\n", min_num);
	return 0;
}
</code></pre>
</details>
<p><strong>运行结果截图</strong><br>
<img alt="屏幕截图 2025-10-19 122222" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3708057/202510/3708057-20251019154827715-244761266.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong>task5.c源代码</strong></p>
<details>
<summary>点击查看代码</summary>
<pre><code>#include&lt;stdio.h&gt;

int main() {

	int a, b, c;

	while (1) {
		scanf("%d %d %d", &amp;a, &amp;b, &amp;c);
		if(a + b &lt;= c || a + c &lt;= b || c + b &lt;= a) {
			printf("不能构成三角形\n"); 
		}
		else {

			if ((a * a) + (b * b) == (c * c) || (c * c) + (b * b) == (a * a) || (a * a) + (c * c) == (a * a)) {
				printf("直角三角形\n");
			}
			else if (a == b&amp;&amp;c != b || a == c&amp;&amp;c != b || b == c&amp;&amp;a != b) {
				printf("等腰三角形\n");
			}
			else if (a == b &amp;&amp; a == c) {
				printf("等边三角形\n");
			}
			else {
				printf("普通三角形\n");
			}
		}
	}
	return 0;
}
</code></pre>
</details>
<p><strong>运行结果截图</strong><br>
<img alt="屏幕截图 2025-10-19 125801" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3708057/202510/3708057-20251019155039401-1681146358.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong>task6.c源代码</strong></p>
<details>
<summary>点击查看代码</summary>
<pre><code>#define _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS
#include&lt;stdio.h&gt;
#include&lt;stdlib.h&gt;
#include&lt;time.h&gt;

int main() {

	int num, i = 0;

	int min = 1, max = 30;
	srand((unsigned int)time(NULL));
	int luckyday = rand() % (max - min + 1) + min;

	printf("猜猜2025年11月哪一天是你的lucky day\n");
	printf("开始喽，你有三次机会，猜吧（1~30）：");
	
	while (i &lt;3) {
		i++;
		scanf("%d", &amp;num);
		if (num == luckyday) {
			printf("哇，猜中了:)\n");
			return 0;
		}
		else if (num &lt; luckyday) {
			printf("你猜的日期早了，你的lucky day还没到呢\n");
		}
		else 
			printf("你猜的日期晚了，你的lucky day在前面哦\n");
			if (i &lt; 3)
			{
				printf("再猜\n");
			}
		}
		printf("次数用光了。偷偷告诉你，11月你的lucky day是%d", luckyday);

	}
</code></pre>
</details>
